contract: Export an explicitly selected canonical Work or ordered Series revision. Every section pins exact work revision, active draft ID, immutable artifact ID/version and SHA-256. Produce durable EPUB 3 container/package metadata/navigation/spine/XHTML/CSS bytes and a print PDF through the registered document renderer. Persist checksummed owner-only download paths and idempotent receipts; missing sources, renderer absence, invalid output or changed bytes fail without placeholder success.
acceptance: EPUB bytes have stored first mimetype, valid container rootfile, OPF identifier/title/creator/language/modified metadata, complete manifest/spine/navigation, contained XHTML chapters and CSS asset.
Print bytes are produced through the actual registered PDF writer and read by pdfplumber/file; renderer absence returns explicit HTTP 503.
Standalone and ordered-series exports retain exact immutable source identities and content hashes across later draft changes and store reopen.
Owner HTTP, console and approval-gated native tool paths create, list and download real checked artifacts without leaking filesystem paths or manuscript text in receipts.

limitations: Shared creative route registration, page mounting and durability inventory enrollment remain root integration hooks.
